meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Codex 设为主智能体,接替 Claude 做规划、调用工具并恢复历史会话。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望终端 AI 的规划与工具调度由 Codex 接管。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex to lead planning and tool calls in your terminal instead of Claude.

howto.what: 装上后,如果某个群组被设为使用 Codex,你的消息就交给 OpenAI Codex 处理而不是 Claude。它负责规划、调用工具等;对话历史存在服务端、可恢复会话,密钥只存在本地保险库。普通聊天本身不会变化,需要管理员先切换。
howto.when: 当你有 OpenAI 账号(ChatGPT 订阅或 API 密钥),想让某个群组或全部群组由 Codex 处理,或要把新群组默认也设为 Codex 时,提出请求即可触发安装/配置流程。

say.text: 帮我把 Codex 接入并保存好我的 OpenAI 密钥。
say.note: Claude 会执行安装并引导认证。

say.text: 把群组 abc 切到 Codex 并重启这个群组。
say.note: 对应运行配置更新和重启命令。

say.text: 以后新建群组都默认用 Codex。
say.note: 经确认后修改默认并重启主机。

howto.what_en: After install, a group's provider can be Codex instead of Claude. Codex handles planning and tool use; history lives server-side; sessions can resume. Credentials are vault-only; default stays Claude until switched.
howto.when_en: When you have an OpenAI account (ChatGPT or API key) and ask for Codex to handle one/all groups, or want new groups to default to Codex.

say_en.text: Add Codex support and store my OpenAI credential.
say_en.note: Claude installs it and runs auth.

say_en.text: Switch group abc to Codex and restart it.
Make new groups use Codex by default.
say_en.note: Confirms, then sets default and restarts host.
